nusmp.configuration.playermodel.tooltip: How the humanoids of the dungeon are drawn (the player model with their own HD skins).
nusmp.configuration.dungeon: Dungeon humanoids on the player model
nusmp.configuration.dungeon.tooltip: On: the Mob Foundry's people, the Living Armor, the Floor Warden, the Labyrinth Guardian, the Goliath and the soul-corpse puppets wear the player model and their skins. Off: the models they had before. No restart needed.
nusmp.configuration.detailDistance.toolt: Beyond this distance a character is drawn without its second skin layer and without hair.
nusmp.configuration.farDistance.tooltip: Beyond this distance the glowing passes of a character are dropped as well.
